cron_jobs.description: List of cron jobs to schedule. Each entry defines when and as which user a command should run.

minute.description: Minute field (0–59, * for any, or range/list e.g. 0,30 or 1-5).

day_of_week.description: Day of week (0–7, where 0 and 7 = Sunday).

user.description: User account to run the command as (e.g., www-data, backup).

command.description: The shell command or script to execute.
